0022600107.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-0, 1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East) host the Houston Rockets (1-0, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) in Atlanta's third game of the 2026-27 season, with both of the Hawks' wins coming on the road and a two-game winning streak. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Houston is missing Reed Sheppard (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Hawks lost 0-2 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 117-95 loss in Houston on March 20, 2026.
